tei:div.tei:p: 270) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i rtsa dbang ye shes snang 'byed bzhugs: 272) na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:

rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la gus pas 'dud: phyi rabs rjes 'jug 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug phyir sgo gsum smin byed thabs zab mo: rtsa dbang ye shes snang 'byed 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: rdo rje slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas: gsang sngags snod ldan skyes bu rigs can ni: shes rab snying rje che zhing ngang rgyud ring: sgo gsum chos la skul zhing dad mos che: dam srung slob mas bsgo ba'i bka' nyan cing: rdo rjai mched la brtse zhing sgo gsum sdom: 'khor bar rgyang bsring dben rir sgrub tshugs bzung: de sogs yon tan ldan pa'i slob ma la: phyi nang gsang ba'i sta gon legs grub nas: bum pa la sogs mkho ba'i yo byad bsags: rdo rje slob dpon chas gsol dbang blangs nas: snod ldan slob mar khrus byas gral du 'khod: bgegs bskrad srung gur yid ches lo rgyus dang: sgo gsum bla ma'i phyogs su maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni: kyai: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin: brtse chen dbang phyug chen po dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: lan gsum gsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: e ma: rigs ldan skyes bu gang su dag: khyed cag las dang skal bar ldan: 273) lam mchog zab mo 'di dang phrad: sngon byon rgyal ba thams cad kyang: lam 'dir 'jug nas don gnyis spyod: 'bras bu mchog gi sa ru gshegs: de phyir khyed cag skal ba bzang: dam bsrung dam dang ldan par gyis: dbang rnams bdag gis bskur bar bya: spro ba bskyed la gus pas longs: yang slob mas lan gsol ba: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs: khyed kyis ci bsgo'i bka' las ni: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam bsrung ngo ཿ tshul bzhin 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: lan gsum gsol: de nas skyabs sems sdom pa 'bogs: slob ma lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ

ye shes gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis: khyod kyi ma rig sgrib pa bsal: rang byung ye shes chen po'i dal: ma bsgom rang grol mngon gyur shog: badz+ra dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas me tog dor ba ni: hoḥ mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: slob ma'i rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon nas 'brel pa gang yod pa'i: lhag pa'i lha der bab par mdzod: 274) ces brjod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sid+dhi tram̐': lan gsum rjes su zlos la dor: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: spros bral chos sku'i bum pa ru: lhun grub 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: thugs rje ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bum dbang yongs su rdzogs thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas rigs bdag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: snang ba mtha' yas dbang bskur ro: rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la: dbang bsgyur dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i sku thogs laḥ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rgyal kun phrin las yongs 'dus dpal: snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas 'jam dpal sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: mkhyen brtse nus gsum bdag nyid dpal: gzungs spobs blo gros gter 'chang ba: mkhyen rab dbang phyug dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas gsang bdag rdo rje'i sku 275) thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rgyal kun phrin las yongs 'dus dpal: mthu stobs mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin: gsang ba'i bdag po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen ye shes ka pā lar: rgyal kun gsung gsang mi zad gter:

a li ka li'i 'od zer 'phro: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par gnas: skal ldan khyod kyi ngag tu blud: gsang dbang yongs su rdzogs thob shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas yig drug thogs la: hūm̐: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi: snying po gcig 'dus yi ge drug: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bzlas pa'i dbang thob don gnyis mthar phyin shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shel dkar phreng ba 'di gtad pas: lha dang rang snang gnyis med pa'i: yongs grub chen por dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas rig tsaka thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen ye shes pho nya mo: sku gsum ḍā ki'i sgyu 'phrul gar: skal ldan bu la 276)dbang bskur ro: dbab bskyil 'dren bkram thabs mkhas kyis: stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon gyur nas: lhan skyes ye shes dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā dz+nyā na su kha tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas mdangs lnga me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag spros bral me long ngor: lhun grub rdzogs pa'i 'od lnga shar: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: mtha' gnyis bral ba'i ye shes dbyings: skye med don gyi dbang thob nas: lhun grub gzhon nu bum pa'i skuḥ mngon gyur chen por sangs rgyas shog: a a āḥ phaṭa: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ḥ chos dbyings rnam dag gtor gzhong du: lhun grub rang gsal gtor ma bshams: ye shes lnga yi gtor rgyan spras: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dkyil 'khor kun la dbang thob nas: rim gnyis dngos grub myur thob shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā ba liṃ ta maṇ+ḍa la sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ de nas mtha' rten gtad cing dam khas blangs: dbang thog sku drin maṇ+ḍal phul: me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang ba gnad: sa ma ya: e ma: zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa mang yod kyang:

kun gyi snying po bcud bsdus zab mo'i 277) chos: tshig nyung don gsal gcus dkrugs gab gsal nas: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab: sa ga hrī dang rdo rje zhi ba mtshor: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba skyob ba'i phyir du gtad: da dung ma spel 'phrul gyi yi ger thob: ma 'ongs snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus: mdo khams chu gsum 'dus pa'i nyo cha ru: chu 'brug lo pa ḍā ki pad+ma'i rigs: chos 'di bton nas 'gro ba'i don byed nges: nag po bdud kyis bstan la ma 'tshe na: gter gnyis bstan pa de yis 'dzin pa 'byung: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: thub par srungs shig badz+ra sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang rang gi nye gnas dam pa bu chung shī la badz+ra dang: bu mo nag tā re gnyis kyi bzhed dor snyoms las pa mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra gyis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa dge'o//
